critical_code_review_comments: server.py still a single 1013-line file; iteration-2 added settings/customers/void but keeps structure clean. Consider splitting into routers before next feature wave.

VALID_SALE = {'status': {'$nin': ['void','cancelled']}} is spread into queries — good; applied to promo revenue, dashboard, pos_summary, reports/sales, reports/finance. Confirmed excluded voided sales from totals.
In create_sale, when discount pushes base to 0 but service_percent>0, tax is still computed on service — acceptable; cross-check with tax rule if ever needed.

void_sale appends negative income lines (good audit trail) rather than deleting the original. This keeps double-entry history but means /finance totals need to sum (not count) — current list_finance/report sums correctly.
customers endpoint uses PERM['customers'] excluding finance (403). Confirmed matches spec. list customers sort='points' is used by $sort on primary key fine for small outlets, add index when scaling.
In recap, 'subtotal'/'discount'/'tax' are raw floats not rounded. Visual rounding happens in UI via rp(); for API consumers consider round(…,2). Minor.
Still using @app.on_event startup/shutdown (deprecated in FastAPI) — migrate to lifespan when convenient.
